item.text: The delay is caused by the page awaiting request-time inventory before React can render any of it. I’m separating that dynamic section behind a Suspense boundary so the product shell—including the title—can stream at navigation time.

item.text:
Updated [app/product/page.tsx](/workspace/app/product/page.tsx:1) so:

- The product title renders immediately during navigation.
- Inventory and pricing load independently behind a Suspense boundary.
- A “Loading inventory...” placeholder appears until dynamic data arrives.

Verified with `npm run build`; `/product` is now partially prerendered with streamed dynamic content.
